name: よもナベ
description: 絵を描く人です/有償依頼は@yomo_na10のDMまでお願いします🙇‍♀️

works.body:
Hello! I like your art, it’s very cute!  

 I would like to request a drawing of my OC Mira. Mira has a wistful and melancholic personality. He is quiet but likes to hang out with his friends. He loves to play in turf wars and uses mostly his roller weapon. 

 Please feel free to choose any outfit or pick a new one that you think would fit him. The composition is up to you as well.   

https://imgur.com/a/7apl6zi

Thank you so much for considering my request!

Hello yomo_na08! I hope you're having a great day so far. I was hoping to make another art request from you. Last time was for my Twitter profile picture, but this time I was hoping you could make me a Twitter header/banner.

What I would like : I would like it to be Splatoon theme again. I was hoping that you could include the really cute character that your drew for me last time along with another character. It could be a squid or octopus with any type of hairstyle and clothes, it doesn't matter to me. I'll leave that up to you. I'm also a really big Pokémon fan, so if you could include a Totodile / Waninoko / ワニノコ and a Mawile / Kucheat / クチート somewhere on there, I would be really happy!

I'm including a link/URL of banner/headed that you drew that I really liked.

https://twitter.com/yomo_na08/status/1616427499591970816?s=46&t=fak2epcOMosfuU76uEDLSg

Hello! I love Splatoon and am trying to find an artist to draw a character! 🦑

Could you draw my Inkling character? Her name is Isabella. She is a very brave and confident girl who loves Anarchy Battles. She also loves her Forge Splattershot Pro, it is her favorite weapon.

I'll leave the pose and details up to you, you can draw her however you like! Thank you!

Her picture and outfit is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zQC8sywKHxlicJVxIVAn6hae2T4sZtVY?usp=sharing

Hello! I would like to request an illustration of my girl inkling.
Her personality is a bit mischievous and she is a hard worker at Grizzco. 
I'd like for her hair to be colored like white chocolate and wearing winter outfits while it's snowing.
I'll leave the composition, pose and expression up to you. Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17oyUp-wDm_L6oJ_SV_0Z2eCvb8Aaav6o

Hello! I contacted you a while ago about an art commission piece of Splatoon. This is actually my first time purchasing an art commission so I'm a little new to this so forgive.

What I want: Since you're the creator of this, I would like you to have full freedom on what you want to draw. The pose, the clothing, what they're doing, etc. I'll leave all that up to you.

What I would like: I would like a drawing of a girl from Splatoon 3. Specifically a female inkling with the default Splatoon 3 girl hair.

Weapons I use if you want to draw them. Again, it's your choice if you want to draw them or not: Splat Duailes, Splatana Wiper

If you want to draw my name somewhere, again, it's up to you. My name is "oddishu" all low caps.

I'm going to include two links. The first link is how I want my hair to be. And the second link, well I just like it and I want to use your commission piece for my new avatar.

Thanks a bunch! If you need any extra info my Twitter handle is @oddishu!

https://twitter.com/yomo_na08/status/1572557637522427905?s=46&t=IuA0fa0Eb9FaeI1ZvbKOJQ
